description: LINEMOD BOP test set - 15 test scenes, 15 unique objects

preprocessing.description: Square resize with padding to maintain aspect ratio. Depth scale 1000.0 converts mm to m.

camera.description: FIXED camera intrinsics per scene (NOT per-frame like YCB-V). Loaded from scene_camera.json.

mesh_scale_description: BOP meshes are in millimeters, convert to meters for pose evaluation

symmetries.description: bowl (3) has continuous Z-axis symmetry, eggbox (10) and glue (11) have discrete symmetries

objects.description: 15 unique objects with simple obj_id naming (obj_1, obj_5) for pipeline consistency

format.description: BOP19 format with visible masks and GT poses in JSON

test_set.description: BOP curated test set with 3000 target frames (200 per scene)

notes: CRITICAL: Depth maps are in PNG format with 1.0mm units (uint16, use depth_scale=1000.0 to convert mm->m)
GT poses in scene_gt.json: cam_R_m2c (flattened 3x3), cam_t_m2c (mm units)
Masks are instance-level BOP format: mask_visib/{frame:06d}_{instance:06d}.png
Object naming: simple obj_id format (obj_1, obj_5) for partonomy compatibility
BOP names (ape, can, duck) stored in frame_info for reference
LINEMOD has 15 unique objects (scenes 1-15 each contain 1 object per scene)
Frame IDs are SPARSE (15, 19, 40, 41...) not dense (0, 1, 2...) like YCB-V
Camera intrinsics are FIXED per scene (unlike YCB-V's per-frame variation)
BOP test targets file: lm_base/test_targets_bop19.json (3000 curated frames)
One2Any's sampling strategy: first occurrence per object per scene becomes reference
